## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete failure or user workflow, and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

Include the command, environment and outcome. Distinguish scripted-model checks, retrieval measurements, real service integration and paid-model results. Preserve failed attempts when reporting an experiment.

## Scope

Explain any changed source permissions, approval boundary, persistent state format or dependency requirement. Use synthetic reproductions; exclude credentials, business logs and other projects' source.
